primary_use_cases: Stateful agents with self-managed memory via tools; research agents; long-horizon task agents
deployment_options: Letta server self-host; Letta Cloud; ADE for agent development
pricing_summary: OSS core; cloud pricing for hosted agents
integration_model: Agent framework — agents call memory tools to page between core, archival, recall; not drop-in LLM interceptor
storage_backends: Archival vector store; recall conversation search; core memory blocks in context
memory_tiers: Core Memory (always in context), Archival Memory (vector search via tools), Recall Memory (conversation history search) — explicit OS metaphor
graph_model: Not primary — relational memory via tools and blocks
extraction_approach: Agent-driven: agent decides what to write to archival/core via tool calls
update_operations: Agent edits core blocks; inserts to archival; recall queries
consolidation_strategy: Sleep-time compute and memory pressure management in MemGPT lineage
temporal_model: Recall ordering; less explicit fact validity than Zep
retrieval_signals: Embedding search on archival; keyword on recall; core is always injected
latency_profile: Extra tool-call rounds add latency vs interceptor prefetch
token_efficiency: Paging reduces tokens vs full history — agent pays tool latency
procedural_memory: Tool schemas and learned procedures in agent state
framework_integrations: Letta-native; comparisons position vs Mem0/Zep for agent builders
benchmark_methodology: Agent task completion benchmarks; MemGPT papers
stated_unsolved_problems: Requires agent framework adoption; not suitable for legacy apps without agent rewrite
known_limitations: Not zero-code; developers must use Letta agent model
memorable_has: Conscious mode as one-shot working memory analog; auto mode per-query retrieval
memorable_lacks: Explicit core/archival/recall tool API; agent-controlled paging
memorable_should_port: Tier semantics: expose optional core_memory block config + archival search tools for Letta users (C4 adapter); episodic→semantic rollup inspired by sleep-time compute
memorable_should_skip: Full MemGPT OS rewrite — conflicts with interceptor thesis
